name: India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
citation: India-Japan CEPA, Article 30 (general rule): qualifying value content of not less than 35 percent, alongside a change in tariff classification for non-originating materials. Sourced from the treaty text as excerpted in the EDIT (Electronic Database of Investment Treaties) database on 2026-09-11 - this is a secondary source; verify against the official CEPA text and the Indian gazette notification giving it effect before relying on this operationally.
